META_DESCRIPTION: Track your grocery spend with precision. FincWin's Groceries envelope shows when your food costs are creeping — before they blow your budget.
HERO_H1:
You think you spend $400
on groceries. You spend $680.
HERO_SUB: Groceries are the most common budget category people underestimate — by an average of $200/month. FincWin's Groceries envelope shows you the honest number, every single week.
PAIN_H2:
Groceries are the budget category
everyone gets wrong.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: Inflation hit your cart before you noticed
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: The same weekly shop cost $120 in 2022 and $155 today. Individually each item seems similar. In total, your grocery bill has risen 29% and your budget hasn't moved.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: The "quick shops" add up to a full shop
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: Monday: $22. Thursday: $34. Saturday: $41. You had three "quick trips" this week that added up to $97. They never feel like real grocery trips but they are.
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, the local organic market — nothing wrong with any of them. But swapping your regular store for even two of these visits adds $40–$60 per month without realising.
FEATURES_H2:
The Groceries envelope:
see every trip, every dollar.
CARD_1_P: Log each grocery trip as you go. Your weekly sub-total builds in real time so you know where you stand before that third trip to Trader Joe's this week.
CARD_2_P: Month-over-month grocery charts reveal creeping inflation at your specific stores. See your personal grocery inflation rate — not the national average.
CARD_3_P: FincWin helps you set a cap based on your real history — not wishful thinking. Start honest. Then beat it.
